Class LoanService

java.lang.Object
com.library.service.LoanService
public class LoanService extends Object
Service responsible for managing the borrowing, returning, and tracking of book and CD loans in the library system.

This service interacts with FileStorage to persist loan data and ensures borrowing rules such as:

  • Items cannot be borrowed if already checked out
  • Due dates depend on media type (Books = 28 days, CDs = 7 days)
  • Returning a book resets its availability
  • Overdue loans can be detected

Supports both BOOK and CD loans using MediaType.

    • borrowBook

      public Loan borrowBook(String userId, String bookId)
      Borrows a book for a user.

      Validates:

      • The book exists
      • The book is not already borrowed
      Sets:
      • Borrow date = today
      • Due date = today + 28 days
      Parameters:
      userId - user who is borrowing
      bookId - ID of the book
      Returns:
      the created Loan
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the book ID does not exist
      IllegalStateException - if the book is already borrowed
